fields.title: Nearly vanishing scarf coverage is numerically ill-conditioned
fields.finding: Fifteen last radius samples leave only 60.96 nm of short-side coverage. A relative thickness perturbation of 3e-13 explains the scale of their negative-budget discrepancies; 12/15 match the exact comparison tolerance under that perturbation. Both sets of margins remain enormously negative.
fields.next_evidence: Exclude nonphysical overlap limits from performance tables or give a conditioning/error estimate. Retain raw values without treating their printed precision as meaningful.
